findings.claim: SharkNinja 10-K FY2025: customers are retailers; largest customer 23.8% of net sales; Amazon, Costco, Walmart each >10% (combined 45.7%); no retail exclusivity. 搜尋未發現客戶導入第二供應商或自製的來源。
findings.excerpt: We have low retailer concentration, with our largest customer representing 23.8% of net sales for the year ended December 31, 2025.

customer_second_source.note: 客戶為零售通路而非元件買方，second-source/in-house 概念僅部分適用；搜尋無私有品牌取代的來源。
